lines: Rin, who possessed the most powerful offensive capability of the three, had slashed at her first.
Her electric katana were swung downwards, leaving azure afterglows gleaming in the empty air.
Her slashes, which were so swift that even Mitsuki couldn't follow them, had been repelled.
The Lady of the Spiders had skillfully used her eight legs, and easily deflected the Thunder Sabres.
Legs so hard that even the electric light blades, which would cut through steel easily, couldn't make a dent in them.
Furthermore, there wasn't even any electric damage, which they could ordinarily deal to enemies just by touching them.
By planting her legs in the ground, she was dissipating the electricity like a lightning rod.
Naturally, Mitsuki had never imagined that Rin's attack would be completely blocked, but that didn't mean that she was idly watching it.
The very moment that she had been about to assist Rin.
Scuttling her spider legs, the enemy approached with alarming speed, and swept out the legs of Mitsuki, who had tried to unleash her Arts.
Mitsuki ended up tumbling over from that strange movement, which was that of a spider itself, and would be impossible for a human-shaped creature.
「I did intend to suck on you later, but I've lost interest now. You should die from my poison.」
Looking down at her, the Lady of the Spiders snapped her mouth open wide.
Venom was spewed out from her maw, which had horrifying fangs.
There was no time to even guard with wind. Mitsuki reflexively shut her eyes.
However, no venom was spit on her.
Instead, there was the splattering sound of it hitting something other than her.
When Mitsuki opened her eyes, Mutsuho was standing in the way between them, and had taken the venom in her place.
The Lady of the Spiders frowned in apparent displeasure.
Venom was spit out like a water pistol, from Mutsuho's mouth this time.
Rather than try to stop it, the Lady of the Spiders dodged, pulling back like she found it foul.
「Oh, what's wrong? Not confident the strength of your poison can compete with mine?」
Being mocked for running away by Mutsuho, she made an irritated-looking face.
In the meantime, Mitsuki and Mutsuho took a distance from her, and recovered their postures.
Rin, whose first attack had been blocked, had also swiftly returned to the pair's side.
「Well, more or less. But you two'd better not get any of that stuff on you.」
Mutsuho was lightly shaking her head.
She appeared to have stopped the attack without batting an eyelid, but it looked like the venom was taking effect after all.
「It was like Kousaka said. To think she'd completely block my swords...」
Rin's tone was unusually subdued as well.
「She's equal to a senior executive from Nomad. No, perhaps even stronger.」
Rin, who had been backing Mitsuki and Mutsuho up all this time, was shaking with fear.
This enemy was on a different level from any other before her.
How could they stand against an opponent that strong?
Alarm slowly broke out in Mitsuki's mind.
「It is too late now for you to realize your folly in opposing me.」
Perhaps having sensed their fear, joy had entered the Lady's voice.
「This is what you all wanted, is it not? Come, now. If you want it back, you should try and take it.」
She lowered one of the dangling balls of thread, and cut the surface cleanly with the tips of her legs.
What had been placed inside was Sanada Homura, whose arms and legs were tucked in against her body.
Her eyes were closed, and she was stiff, as though dead.
Mitsuki called out to her, but there was no response.
But, if she looked closely, there was some redness left in Homura's skin, and her chest was going up and down, albeit slightly.
「I did suck out quite a lot of its life essence, but it is still alive. It would taste bad if it died, after all.」
「Shall I show you how I'm going to eat this one? Mm?」
「Or will the insects scurry back home, as insects do? That would be fine as well.」
The Lady of the Spiders was poking Homura's body with the tip of her leg, as if to provoke them.
Mitsuki couldn't say anything in return.
Rin's Thunder Sabres, which had the greatest attack power, had been defended against easily.
Mutsuho had taken poison head-on, to save her.
And Mitsuki could not manifest her wind powers to the fullest extent inside a room like this.
She couldn't think of any means of attack.
She ground her teeth, due to her own incompetence in not being able to issue directions as the leader.
「Your analytical skill. I chose you as leader because I value that.」
「I'd like you to use that analytical skill to put my poison to good use too, Prez.」
「I got told a little while back that if you use the special traits of the poisons produced in my body, it makes for a great Ninja Art.」
Mutsuho smiled as best she could, as she counteracted the enemy's toxin.
「Did you hear that from that Fuuma-san?」
「Who knows? For now, let's do something about this.」
Mitsuki nodded forcefully, and gazed firmly at the Lady of the Spiders.
「The flies seem eager for some reason.」
「Very well. Here is your reward for managing to reach my manor. You may try all you like.」
She didn't seem to have any intention of attacking Mitsuki and the others straight away.
Her face said that she didn't believe she would be defeated in the slightest.
She probably believed that she could kill them any time she wanted to.
The difference in strength may indeed have been that vast.
But, that was precisely why Mitsuki needed to connect the Lady's arrogance to victory.
Did winning here mean taking down their enemy?
The Lady of the Spiders had gone out of her way to locate the ball of thread that Homura was held in for them.
She had just blocked Rin's slash attack head-on, yet had dodged Mutsuho's poison.
Obviously, since she was a living thing, it wasn't like poison would have no effect on her at all, was it?
In the same way that Mutsuho, who had acquired a resistance to every type of poison from an early age, was suffering from the enemy's venom, even if she wasn't going to die from it.
Mitsuki turned her back on the Lady of the Spiders, and, while using her wind to make sure that their voices didn't leak out, explained the battle plan to Mutsuho and Rin.
She was confident that the Lady absolutely would not do anything like attack her from behind.
The two of them accepted Mitsuki's strategy without hesitation.
The Lady of the Spiders was looking at them with the kind of eyes that a human would make upon finding a bug in a basket.
「Yes, we've decided! Sorry to have kept you waiting!」
Mitsuki daringly smiled, and even bowed her head.
「Strange flies you are. Do try and amuse me as best you can.」
Mitsuki and Rin simultaneously broke into runs.
Without any artifice, they readied their respective weapons overhead, and charged straight for her.
「I shall commend you for not running away.」
The Lady of the Spiders hadn't moved.
Showing enough composure to compliment Mitsuki and the others, she tried to engage them head-on.
She used her unfolded fan as a blade, and Rin slashed at the Lady with her Thunder Sabres, the same way as before.
The Lady of the Spiders once again blocked Mitsuki and Rin's simultaneous attacks with her legs.
The two of them put their strength into their combined weapons.
Fierce sparks flew, but the eight legs wouldn't budge.
「Foolish. No matter if it goes up from one fly to two, it shall make no difference.」
The Lady of the Spiders said, looking bored, but this was a diversion.
While the two of them were making their grandiose attack, Mutsuho had gone around behind the enemy.
「I've scented you the whole time, dolt!」
Behaving as they expected, the Lady this time spat web at Mutsuho, whom poison would not work on.
「I wonder which one of us that is!!」
Mutsuho was restrained in an instant, but that itself had been her aim.
Purple poison wafted out from her body, which the web had wrapped around.
The Lady of the Spiders tried to dodge that once again.
However, unlike the poison squirt gun from before, the toxic mist this time around attacked her as though it had a mind of its own.
The Lady of the Spiders was tottering.
She tried to use her eight legs to support her body, as though it had caused vertigo or something.
What Mutsuho had generated was an extremely powerful arachnicide poison.
Even with that, it had no greater effect than to make the Lady stagger slightly.
Mitsuki unleashed her Ninja Art without a moment's delay.
It created a huge tornado inside the room.
A windstorm raged across it and made a mess of the place, lifting up the chairs and sofa, and even ostentatiously toppling over the canopy bed.
「How dare you commit such an outrage to my chamber!」
She was groaning with the most displeasure so far, but even the Lady could do nothing but jab her legs into the floor and hold on, trying not to be blown away by the wind.
In the middle of that storm―――
Rin leapt upwards, and promptly caught Sanada Homura, who had flown high up on the wind.
Rin landed with Homura in her arms, and dashed out of the room without hesitation.
「Spider Lady-san, since we're no match for you, we'll just be taking Sanada-san back home with us.」
「You should've made this thread a bit better. Also, sorry you lost your afternoon snack for the day.」
Mutsuho had also dissolved the spider thread with her own poison, and was taking flight with those mocking words.
Finally, Mitsuki created two or three tornadoes as a parting gift, and
After saying goodbye just to be sure, started running away as fast as she could.
The Lady of the Spiders was screaming, but the room was going to be a raging storm for a while.
She wouldn't be able to get out for some time.
By planning only to rescue Homura, Mitsuki and the others had successfully outwitted the Lady of the Spiders.
Furious screams were rapidly drawing near from the other end of the sewers.
It was the Lady of the Spiders, who had chased after Mitsuki and the others after the storm in her room had subsided.
All the composure she had had before had completely disappeared, and she looked enraged.
「You've chased after us, I see, Spider Lady-san.」
Mitsuki met her at the end of an underground passage, which extended straight ahead a long way.
The figures of Rin and Mutsuho, who were supposed to be escaping with her, and Homura, whom they had rescued, were nowhere to be seen.
However, the infuriated Lady of the Spiders looked like she didn't even notice that.
「You bitch!! How dare you deceive me!!」
「It was part of our plan from the start to just save Sanada-senpai and run away. We'd heard you were awfully strong, after all.」
「No matter what you say now, it's too late! I shall torture you to death myself, make you regret ever being born!」
Baring her anger, the Lady of the Spiders rubbed her eight legs together.
「I don't really want that, so sorry about one more thing. I apologize in advance.」
Perhaps thrown off by the composed-looking Mitsuki, the Lady of the Spiders asked her that.
「Planning to run away is one kind of strategy for dealing with an opponent who's chasing you.」
「It's a modest tactic for defeating a tailing enemy.」
「I never thought Spider Lady-san would fall for it.」
The Lady of the Spiders looked alarmed.
「My turn at last, huh?! If it's to save Homura-no-Anego, then I gotta drop in, y'know!」
The one who had appeared assertively from the shadows was Kamimura Maika.
Despite still being a student at Gosha Academy, she was a top-class flame-wielding Taimanin.
She was the secret weapon of which Shizuru had spoken prior to their raid, and it seemed that she greatly idolized the abducted Homura as her valued senpai in the Fire Escape Arts.
「Yo yo yo! You that piece o' shit called the Spider Lady or whatever?!」
「I hear ya did a number on Homura-no-Anego, yeah?」
「Thanks to you, my flames are on another level today! Eat a load o' them here!!」
Maika shot caustic comments at the Lady, in her gruff, delinquent manner of speaking.
That moment, flames erupted from her entire body, and flared up with tremendous power.
It appeared that the Lady, being a spider monster, harboured instinctive fear towards those red-hot flames.
Her graceful face had gone completely stiff, and her eight legs were also rigid.
Her figure was somewhat pitiful, like a spider caught in an insect net.
「This water channel is a straight line. You can't escape from the top-ranking fire power in the Taimanin.」
「Spider Lady-san, you lost at the moment you started to chase after us.」
Maika readied the cannon she named her Death Bazooka, and fired an ultra-high-temperature fireball.
A burst of flame so intense that the sewer passage was blanketed red from one end to the other.
With no escape, the Lady's body was engulfed in red-hot flame in an instant.
She bundled together her legs, which had stiffened with fear, desperately trying to block the flames.
However, despite them boasting so much strength, those legs, and her beautiful face, were roasted by the ultra-high heat, turned red hot, and developed tiny cracks.
「D...... Damn yooouuu...... D-Do you think I...... would be...... would be beaten by something like......」
「Hangin' in there, are ya?! Mitsuki-senpai, I'll leave it to you to polish 'er off!」
Mitsuki swung her fan downwards forcefully.
A gust of wind blew through the sewer tunnel, where the flames burned brightly.
That served as a bellows, and the level of heat immediately skyrocketed.
With that death scream, the Lady of the Spiders broke into pieces.
That was also the end for Tsuchigumo.
After that, Sanada Homura had regained consciousness, and all the other people who were being held captive by Tsuchigumo had been rescued as well.
With the death of the Lady of the Spiders, Yomihara's power structure was rewritten.
And the names of the Independent Commando Unit, and Hoshino Mitsuki, the Taimanin who had brought death to her, had come to thunder throughout the criminal underworld.
